title: Online Safety & Privacy
description: Online safety and privacy including browser security, spam and phishing prevention, digital tracking, and safe browsing.
short_description: Stay safe online with essential security and privacy skills

modules.title: Browser Security & Threat Awareness
modules.description: Learn to recognize and protect yourself from common online threats like phishing and spam.

lessons.title: Internet Safety: Your Browser's Security Features
lessons.content: Understand the built-in security features of your web browser and how to use them effectively.

lessons.title: Understanding Spam and Phishing
lessons.content: Learn how to identify spam emails and phishing attempts to protect your personal information.

lessons.title: Online Shopping Advice
lessons.content: Stay safe while shopping online with tips on secure payments, trusted sites, and avoiding scams.

modules.title: Privacy & Digital Tracking
modules.description: Understand how your data is tracked online and how to protect your privacy on social media.

lessons.title: Understanding Digital Tracking
lessons.content: Learn how websites and advertisers track your online activity and what you can do about it.

lessons.title: Facebook: Understanding Privacy
lessons.content: Navigate Facebook's privacy settings to control who sees your posts and personal information.
